capabilities: set a note as the homepage by path
open the homepage via a command or ribbon icon
open the homepage automatically on startup when only an empty tab is present
open the homepage in a new window, tab, or split using modifier clicks
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (Korean/English) and includes a todo list of unimplemented click behaviors; the author states it is their first plugin and was built as part of a larger planned workflow.
intentEvidence: obsidian-homepage by novov likely already covers what most people need. This plugin, however, was built as one piece of a larger workflow
motivation: The author uses an index note as a homepage and wanted it to work like a web browser, paired with a keyboard shortcut, treating a new tab and the homepage as separate concerns.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to designate a note as a homepage that behaves like a browser homepage with its own open command and startup behavior.

relations.evidence: obsidian-homepage by novov likely already covers what most people need
Inspired by obsidian-homepage by novov. As this is my first Obsidian plugin, I referenced novov's code

summary: Homepage plugin that opens a designated note like a browser's start page, via command, ribbon icon, or automatically on startup.
